Body.Content:
This feature contains several related enhancements. New functionality includes:

• When you create project intercompany customer invoices, you can choose Both, Invoices, or Credit notes to control whether charges and credits are processed together or separately.

• Transaction date and transaction balance criteria help you target the transactions needed for a billing or financial period.

• Intercompany invoice lines provide additional context about the resource and originating documents, such as expense reports and vendor invoices, where available. Transactions originating in Dataverse will have a link to the integration journal line.

• Credit notes generated from an intercompany transaction retain a relationship to the original free text invoice so finance teams and customizations can trace credits back to the initial charge.

This feature is off by default and is enabled by administrators. To enable it, open the Feature management workspace, search for Enhance intercompany invoicing filters and details, select the feature, and then select Enable now.

This feature is specific to Dynamics 365 Project Operations connected with ERP and manufacturing deployment types.
